card.name: Mixing doses into soft food
card.fires_on: Linking words and commas just before a soft food or drink, in directions for crushing tablets or opening capsules (e.g. 'added to', 'sprinkled on', 'mixed with' applesauce, juice, yogurt).

modes.label: Verb plus linking word
modes.description: The verb or small word after crushing or opening a dose, right before the food it goes into.
modes.example: Tablets may be crushed and added<< to>> semi-solid food.

modes.label: Commas in food lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of foods or drinks used to mix the medicine.
